articles.description:
A Connecticut hotel is also a top waterfront spot.

articles.title: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt, youngest person to hold role, to leave at month’s end
articles.description:
Leavitt, 28, just recently returned to the White House after taking a brief leave for the birth of her second child in May.

The post White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt, youngest person to hold role, to leave at month’s end appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Karoline Leavitt, 28, will leave her role as White House press secretary at month's end.
Leavitt recently returned from maternity leave after the birth of her second child in May.
Her departure may impact Boston's representation in the federal government.
